annotations.title: Create a public link to share

description: Uses no credits. Mints a public no-login link that anyone can open, including someone with no account, for sending a page, design or audit to someone else. App and dashboard links need a login; this link does not. Pass build_run_id to share a finished built page. Pass concept_id to share a design; it comes back as one page with every band stacked in order, and it prints to PDF from the browser if they want a file. One or the other, not both. Pass audit_id to share the AUDIT itself, and section:"competitors" with it to open the link on the Competitors section rather than the whole report. export_page returns the source files instead. For a build, a new link revokes the previous one. A design link is stable.

audit_id.description: Share an AUDIT. From audit_page or get_audit. Use this when someone wants to forward the findings themselves rather than a design or a built page.

build_run_id.description: Share a finished built page. From build_page or get_build.

concept_id.description: Share a design the user already has and asks to send. From get_concepts. For a client, share the built page instead.

section.description: Which part of the audit the link opens. Only with audit_id. `competitors` opens on who is bidding against the page, for forwarding that one answer. Defaults to full.

name: share_page
